resource: Tracked quests of one GameSession (domain 16 QUEST_LOG tracker)
allocation_impact: QUEST-GATE-0 §9 value (PARITY_PENDING). A track query names at most 10 distinct listed quests and replaces the set; the tracker shows each one's visible missions as one quest line of at most QUESTGATE0-RL-08-BYTES. An eleventh index fails closed in the codec and the query is REJECTED.
boundary_tests: max=10: ten tracked quests encode, decode and are tracked
max+1=11: an eleventh index fails closed both ways and the track query is REJECTED without effect
notes: QUEST-GATE-0 §7 and §9 (PARITY_PENDING: Tibia's tracker limit is not yet evidenced); tests: quest_log::tests::queries_round_trip_within_62_bytes_and_fail_closed, quest_log::tests::the_domain_holds_a_view_and_10_tracked_lines_within_its_bound, gameplay_transport::connection::quest_log::tests::track_replaces_the_set_and_refuses_unlisted_or_eleven_quests.
